channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Weather-roiling El Nino hits record strength, Japan weather agency says
item.description: Sea temperatures in the tropical Pacific Ocean were 4C above normal as of September, the highest in records going back to 1949, the JMA said.

item.title: Is iPhone 18 demand cooling off? Here’s how deep Apple reportedly is cutting component orders.
item.description: Component orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro Max are down about 15% in October, according to Nikkei Asia.

item.title: Japan’s Prudential Life ordered to halt operations for over three months
item.description: The suspension order comes after numerous former and current employees were found in January to have improperly received ¥3.1 billion from customers.

item.title: Japan sees record number of workers’ compensation approvals for mental health in fiscal 2025
item.description: The figure, published in this year's white paper on measures to prevent karōshi, marked a record high for the seventh consecutive year.

item.title: SoftBank seeks $100 billion from Gulf states for AI, FT says
item.description: Founder Masayoshi Son has held early talks with potential investors including those in the United Arab Emirates, the newspaper said.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
